name: smart-nutrition-weight-tracker
description: Mobile-friendly AI food calorie analysis and weight tracking app with Gemini vision

scripts.build: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { if (fs.existsSync('./client/package.json')) { import('child_process').then(cp => { cp.execSync('npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build', {stdio: 'inherit'}); try { if (!fs.existsSync('./server/public')) fs.mkdirSync('./server/public', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('./client/dist', './server/public', {recursive: true}); console.log('Successfully synced dist to server/public'); } catch(e) { console.error('Sync public error:', e); } }); } else { console.log('Client package.json not found, using prebuilt server/public assets.'); } });"
